claude.rationale: This was a whole-company cash-out merger with the Company surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Abbott, so the core diagnostics product line (T4) transferred together with its operational processes (T5) inside the same surviving corporation — no product-vs-process mismatch at closing (gap_45=0). The only carve-outs (Triage MeterPro and BNP Test) were sold to Quidel, but for those the process substrate was explicitly bridged by mutual transition-services and manufacturing/supply agreements, so even the carved products moved with aligned process. T5 processes and the T6 organization/people remained co-located in the same surviving entity, with employee compensation/benefits contractually fixed through year-end 2017 (T6 partial due to no retention guarantee), so processes did not transfer without their people (gap_56=0). T4 coded subset because two named product lines were carved out of the customer-facing bundle.

gemini.rationale: The transaction was a whole-company acquisition where Alere became a wholly owned subsidiary of Abbott. While certain product lines (Triage and BNP) were carved out for antitrust reasons, the slice notes that the process substrate for those carved-out products was bridged by transition-services and manufacturing/supply agreements, meaning the products and their processes were aligned. There is no documented structural mismatch between T4 and T5, nor between T5 and T6 at closing.

grok.rationale: At closing the whole-company cash merger left Alere as surviving Abbott subsidiary, so the retained customer-facing diagnostics products (T4) and the operational processes that produce them (T5) crossed together inside the same legal vehicle; the only products that did not cross to Abbott were the Triage MeterPro and BNP lines carved out to Quidel under separate purchase agreements, which is a perimeter reduction rather than a product-without-process mismatch on the Abbott boundary (gap_45=0). Employees of the Company remained employees of the surviving corporation at the effective time, with compensation and benefits contractually continued through year-end 2017 and no structural separation of processes from the organization that runs them, so gap_56=0; gap_mitigated is therefore NA.
